# Medical News Today

> Evidence-based medical news, condition guides, and wellness information for patients, caregivers, and general readers.

Medical News Today publishes daily health news alongside medically reviewed articles on diseases, symptoms, treatments, nutrition, mental health, and healthy living. Content is organized into topic hubs, condition centers, and practical explainers intended to make current medical information accessible.

## Core Site Areas
- [Home](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/): Main entry point for health news, featured articles, and topic navigation.
- [News](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/news): Daily medical and health news coverage across research, public health, and medicine.
- [Health Conditions](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/health): Broad index of disease and condition coverage across body systems and specialties.
- [Nutrition](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/nutrition): Articles on foods, diets, nutrients, and evidence-based nutrition guidance.
- [Mental Health](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/mental-health): Coverage of mental health conditions, symptoms, treatments, and self-care topics.
- [Human Body](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/human-body-maps): Anatomy and body system reference content with visual educational resources.
- [Medical Myths](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/medical-myths): Myth-busting articles that examine common health misconceptions using evidence.
- [Opinion](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/opinion): Expert and editorial perspectives on medicine, health policy, and research.

## Major Condition Hubs
- [Cancer](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cancer): Cancer news, explainers, and guides on symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.
- [Cardiovascular Health](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cardiovascular-health): Heart health coverage including blood pressure, stroke, cholesterol, and prevention.
- [Diabetes](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/diabetes): Type 1, type 2, gestational diabetes, symptoms, management, and complications.
- [Alzheimer's & Dementia](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/alzheimers-and-dementia): Information on dementia types, symptoms, caregiving, and brain health.
- [Anxiety](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/anxiety): Anxiety disorder coverage including symptoms, causes, and treatment options.
- [Depression](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/depression): Depression guides covering signs, diagnosis, therapies, and support strategies.
- [HIV and AIDS](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/hiv-and-aids): HIV and AIDS information on transmission, testing, treatment, and living well.
- [Asthma and Allergies](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/asthma-and-allergies): Respiratory and allergy content on triggers, symptoms, and management.

## Health News Topics
- [Public Health](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/public-health): Reporting on population health, prevention, policy, and health equity.
- [Primary Care](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/primary-care): News and explainers relevant to general practice and routine care.
- [Clinical Trials / Drug Trials](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/drug-trials): Coverage of clinical research, investigational therapies, and trial findings.
- [Genetics](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/genetics): Research news on genes, inherited conditions, and genomic medicine.
- [Immune System / Vaccines](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/immune-system-vaccines): Articles on immunity, vaccination, and infectious disease prevention.
- [Neurology / Neuroscience](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/neurology-neuroscience): Brain and nervous system research, disorders, and treatment developments.
- [Surgery](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/surgery): Surgical news and explainers on procedures, risks, and recovery.
- [Medical Innovation](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/medical-innovation): Emerging technologies, devices, and advances in healthcare.

## Nutrition and Diet
- [Nutrition Overview](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/nutrition): Central nutrition section covering diets, foods, and nutrient science.
- [What to Eat for...](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/what-to-eat-for): Food-focused guides tailored to conditions and health goals.
- [Vitamins](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/vitamins): Reference articles on vitamins, deficiency, benefits, and food sources.
- [Supplements](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/supplements): Evidence-based coverage of supplements, uses, risks, and interactions.
- [Food Allergies](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/food-allergy): Articles on food allergy symptoms, diagnosis, and avoidance strategies.
- [Weight Management](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/obesity-weight-loss-fitness): Content on obesity, weight loss, exercise, and metabolic health.

## Mental Health and Neurology
- [Mental Health Overview](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/mental-health): Index of mental health conditions, therapies, and wellness topics.
- [Bipolar](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/bipolar): Guides to bipolar disorder symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.
- [Schizophrenia](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/schizophrenia): Information on psychosis, schizophrenia symptoms, and care approaches.
- [ADHD](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/adhd): Coverage of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in children and adults.
- [Autism](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/autism): Autism spectrum disorder articles on traits, diagnosis, and support.
- [Headache and Migraine](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/headache-and-migraine): Evidence-based migraine and headache information, triggers, and treatment.
- [Epilepsy](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/epilepsy): Seizure disorder coverage including symptoms, diagnosis, and medications.

## Body Systems and Anatomy
- [Human Body Maps](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/human-body-maps): Interactive anatomy reference for organs, systems, and body structures.
- [Bones / Orthopedics](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/bones-orthopedics): Musculoskeletal conditions, injuries, and bone health information.
- [Dermatology](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/dermatology): Skin conditions, symptoms, treatments, and skincare explainers.
- [Ear, Nose, and Throat](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/ear-nose-and-throat): ENT conditions, infections, and symptom guides.
- [Gastrointestinal / Gastroenterology](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/gastrointestinal-gastroenterology): Digestive health coverage including symptoms, disorders, and testing.
- [Endocrinology](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/endocrinology): Hormone-related conditions such as thyroid disease and metabolic disorders.
- [Respiratory](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/respiratory): Lung and breathing condition coverage beyond asthma and allergies.
- [Urology / Nephrology](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/urology-nephrology): Kidney, urinary tract, and male reproductive health topics.

## Lifestyle and Wellness
- [Fitness](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/fitness): Exercise guidance, workout benefits, and physical activity research.
- [Sleep](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/sleep): Sleep disorders, sleep hygiene, and circadian health explainers.
- [Sexual Health / STDs](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/sexual-health-stds): Sexual health education, STI information, and prevention guidance.
- [Women's Health / Gynecology](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/womens-health-gynecology): Reproductive health, menopause, pregnancy, and gynecologic conditions.
- [Men's Health](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/mens-health): Articles on male health concerns, screening, and wellness.
- [Pregnancy / Obstetrics](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/pregnancy-obstetrics): Pregnancy stages, symptoms, prenatal care, and maternal health.
- [Pediatrics / Children's Health](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/pediatrics-childrens-health): Child development, pediatric conditions, and family health topics.

## Reference and Educational Content
- [Medical Myths](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/medical-myths): Evidence-based myth checks on common beliefs about health and disease.
- [Symptoms](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/categories/symptoms): Symptom-focused articles linking signs to possible causes and next steps.
- [Drugs](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/drugs): Medication information including uses, side effects, dosage, and warnings.
- [Clinical Terms / Medical Dictionary](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/medical-dictionary): Definitions and explanations of common medical terminology.
- [Quizzes](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/quizzes): Interactive health quizzes for education and self-assessment.
- [Health Tools](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/tools): Calculators and practical tools supporting health education and tracking.

## Editorial and About
- [About Us](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/about): Overview of the publication, mission, and editorial approach.
- [Editorial Process](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/about/editorial-process): How content is created, reviewed, updated, and quality-checked.
- [Fact-checking Process](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/about/fact-checking): Standards and workflow for verifying medical and scientific claims.
- [Medical Affairs Team](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/about/medical-affairs-team): Information about clinical review and medical oversight contributors.
- [Our Experts](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/about/our-experts): Profiles of medical reviewers and expert contributors.
- [Contact Us](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/contact): Contact information for editorial, business, and general inquiries.
